interface.title: Western Blot 定量ツール (Western Blot Quantifier) v5.0 • Multi-Threshold Detection
interface.field: Molecular biology / protein biochemistry (Western blot densitometry)
interface.stage_of_work: Data analysis: quantifying bands in a gel or blot image after imaging, before statistics
interface.what_it_is_for: Upload a Western blot image, find the band row(s) and the bands in them automatically without giving a lane count, check them on an overlay and a horizontal intensity profile, and export each lane's volume and its percentage of the strongest band as a CSV.

data.note: I used all three test files. test_image.png is 1090×76 px with 1 row. test_image2.png is 1186×146 px; the app found 3 'rows' at y=36, 59 and 122, which are really one sloping band row cut into three. user_image.png is 924×84 px with 1 row, and it already has green boxes and yellow labels drawn into the pixels from an earlier run. Those lines make spikes in its profile, so its results are not clean. The UI is in Japanese. The Japanese text on the matplotlib charts (titles and axis labels) shows as empty boxes because the font is missing.

features.name: Band-row picker before detection
features.general: When an image holds several horizontal strips of signal, find them automatically, list each one by its vertical position, and let the user choose one strip to analyse
features.specific: After upload the app reports 'N 行検出'. If N > 1, the 📍 解析するバンド行を選択 selectbox lists 行 k (y=…). Choose one, then press 🔬 解析 to detect bands only in that row. Caution: the only multi-row case seen (test_image2.png, rows at y=36, 59, 122) was a single sloping band row wrongly cut into three, so this evidence comes from a row-detection mistake, not a true multi-row blot.
steps: read the row count under the image
open the row selectbox and pick 行 k (y=…)
serves_tasks: Choose which of several detected rows to analyse
Detect bands automatically without saying how many lanes there are

features.name: Auto band detection with an annotated overlay and class counts
features.general: Detect objects in an image without being told how many there are, draw numbered boxes over the image next to the original, and show counts per class
features.specific: 🔬 解析 runs multi-threshold detection. 検出結果 shows green boxes with cyan lane numbers beside 元画像. Badges show 🟢 濃 (strong), 🟡 薄 (weak) and 📊 計 (total); strong vs weak is a fixed peak-intensity cutoff (max intensity > 30, app.py:296) with no user control, and no 薄 band appeared in this run. The overlay can be opened fullscreen (shown on a clean image in check/screens/014.webp; screens/045.webp is user_image.png, whose boxes were already drawn into the pixels).
steps: compare 元画像 with 検出結果 side by side
open the overlay fullscreen to check box placement
serves_tasks: Detect bands automatically without saying how many lanes there are
Enlarge the annotated image to check the boxes closely
See which bands the tool classes as strong and which as weak

features.name: Merge-threshold re-segmentation loop
features.general: Tune one sensitivity parameter that merges over-split segments, re-run detection and compare how many objects come out
features.specific: The マージ閾値 slider (0.50–0.85, default 0.68) sets the width fraction of the median below which a band is merged with its neighbour. Changing it clears the current results; press 🔬 解析 again. On test_image.png it gave 13 bands at 0.50, 11 at 0.68 and 3 at 0.84. At 0.50 the 93-px lane 7 split into two bands of 41 and 36 px.
steps: move the slider (drag, or Home/End keys)
compare the band count and the boxes
serves_tasks: Adjust detection sensitivity when bands are split or merged wrongly

screens_never_reached: A result with any 🟡 薄 (weak) band: all 5 analyses across the 3 test images marked every band 🟢 濃, so I never saw the weak class
Results still on screen after a CSV download: pressing 📥 CSVダウンロード reruns the app and goes back to the '「解析」をクリック…' state (screens/015.webp, screens/042.webp)
The threshold controls named in the guide (低閾値, 最小面積, 高閾値, 薄いバンド判定値): the guide refers to them, but the app's sidebar has only マージ閾値 and プロファイル表示
not_done: Telling strong from weak bands could not be fully tested: no image gave a 薄 band, and the strong/weak cutoff is fixed in code (max intensity > 30, app.py:296) with no UI control
The guide's other tuning advice (lower 低閾値, raise 最小面積, raise 高閾値, lower 薄いバンド判定値) could not be followed because those controls are not in this version
The README's parameters (検出感度 0.3, 最小バンド幅, マージ距離) do not exist in the v5.0 app either, which has only マージ閾値; like the in-app guide, the README does not match the app
The data grid's own download icon gave no file in the headless browser (screens/025.webp); the 📥 CSVダウンロード button worked

I did not judge detection accuracy rigorously. Detected counts (11 at the default 0.68, 13 at 0.50) do not obviously match the roughly 12 visible lanes on test_image.png. test_image2's single sloping band row was cut into 3 rows. user_image.png has old annotations drawn into the image that distort its profile
Japanese chart titles and axis labels show as empty boxes because of a missing font, so I read the chart meanings from the section headings
I did not follow the GitHub link, which is outside the allowed host
